category_edits.rationale: Test an untried pooling half-life of 3.5 interactions, between the successful three- and four-interaction configurations. Retain the 80% current-state and 20% causal-mean blend, exclude padding and future states, and synchronize predictor metadata. All other settings remain fixed across the four category models.

response.change_summary: Change causal pooling half-life from 3 to 3.5 and synchronize checkpoint metadata with the embedded predictor validation, preserving one GRU4Rec model per category.
